transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in the ATM system to protect users from financial loss and ensure reliable operations. SAF-01 ensures no account can have a negative balance, preventing overdrafts. SAF-02 guarantees automatic fund withdrawal from savings, enhancing reliability. SAF-03 informs users of insufficient funds, preventing unexpected transaction failures. SAF-04 logs transactions for accountability, while SAF-05 secures user authentication. SAF-06 allows limited withdrawals during maintenance, ensuring service continuity. SAF-07 provides users with clear account summaries, enhancing trust and reliability.

transcript.statement: Sustainability is crucial for the ATM system to minimize its environmental impact. requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account only when sufficient funds are available.
The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall allow limited withdrawals during maintenance while prioritizing energy-saving measures.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.
The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall assess the environmental impact of its operations annually and report findings to stakeholders.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: These requirements all aim to prevent negative balances.
Automatic fund withdrawal must be conditioned on sufficient funds.
Both requirements address limited withdrawals during maintenance with energy-saving considerations.
